description: This file defines a utility support structure for browser discovery of network services using Apple's Network framework. It provides a method to create and configure an NWBrowser instance for Bonjour service discovery, with callback handlers for state changes and result updates.

methods.name: makeBrowser
methods.description: Creates and configures an NWBrowser to discover Bonjour services, with handlers for state updates and result changes, running on a specified dispatch queue.
